tagline: A two-axis pad that sends MIDI CCs as you drag it
description: An on-screen XY pad that sends two MIDI control change messages, one for each axis, on a chosen channel whenever you click or drag in it. Use it to control filter cutoff, expression or any mapped parameter on a downstream instrument with one gesture. It is built as an audio effect with MIDI output (not a MIDI effect), it silences any audio passing through it, and CCs are only sent from mouse movement in the open editor, not from host automation of the X and Y parameters.

features.name: XY pad
features.description: Dragging the ball sets X and Y from 0 to 1, shown on a grid with a live coordinate readout.

features.name: Assignable CC numbers
features.description: X CC and Y CC choose controllers 1 to 127 (defaults CC 1 mod wheel and CC 11 expression).

features.name: MIDI channel
features.description: Sends on any channel from 1 to 16.

features.name: Saved position
features.description: X Position and Y Position are host parameters, so the pad position is saved with the session and restored when the editor opens.
